source_title: Light up Wooden Christmas Houses Snow Scene Decorative Lamp
description: A festive tabletop scene set against a soft white background. The surface is covered in scattered faux white snow material. A large decorative illuminated house ornament — a gabled brown wood and white snow-dusted miniature cottage with arched windows — is positioned as the centerpiece, its interior windows glowing warm golden amber from within. Flanking the house, small white snow-flocked miniature evergreen trees and pinecones are arranged on the snowy base. A small cream paper tree and a single pinecone sit to the right. In the soft-focus background, golden fairy light bokeh from a garland and the green branches of a Christmas tree add warmth and seasonal depth. To the far right edge, the corner of a white wall or door frame is visible. The mood is magical, quiet, and nostalgically festive — a classic Christmas village vignette in white and gold. A warm amber glow at surface level emanates from within the decorative house ornament, pooling softly onto the white snow surface below and around it. Camera at seated eye-level, normal lens, off-center wide vignette composition framing the house ornament from slightly below. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
